title: Rebook: Redwood demo for Novomed — timezone mismatch on Thu 8 Jul
text:
Rebook: Redwood demo for Novomed — timezone mismatch on Thu 8 Jul

["From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Asha Reddy <asha@novomed.com>, Tom Liu <tom.liu@novomed.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-06T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood demo for Novomed — Thu Jul 8 at 10:00

Hi Asha / Tom,

Thanks for your time last week — excited to walk through Redwood Inference and how we can help with your model serving and cost goals. Can we lock in a 30-minute demo on Thu, Jul 8 at 10:00?

I penciled 10:00 AM (we're in PDT) and included a Zoom link below. If that is inconvenient for your team in APAC I can open an evening slot as well — let me know preferred windows.

Zoom: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/987654321
Attached: Novomed-demo-deck-v3.pdf
Calendar invite: will go out after you confirm — I set the slot in my calendar as 2026-07-08 10:00 (UTC-7).

Agenda (30m)
- Quick intro & goals (5m)
- Live demo (15m)
- Q&A / next steps (10m)

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

---
", 'From: Asha Reddy <asha@novomed.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Liu <tom.liu@novomed.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T02:05:00+08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo for Novomed — Thu Jul 8 at 10:00

Hi Irene —

Apologies — we missed the demo this morning. My calendar showed the invite for 10:00 PM (22:00) Singapore Time, so we assumed the session was later.

Can we reschedule for a morning SGT slot? Best availability for our team: Fri Jul 9, 09:00–11:00 SGT or Mon Jul 12, 08:30–10:30 SGT. If you can send an invite with the slot in SGT that would help — sometimes the calendar auto-converts if the organizer sets the wrong timezone.

Thanks — sorry for the inconvenience.
Asha
Asha Reddy
Head of Data Science, Novomed Health
asha@novomed.com

On Thu, Jul 8, 2026 at 02:02 AM +08:00 Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com> wrote:
> (original invite details omitted)

---
', "From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Asha Reddy <asha@novomed.com>, Tom Liu <tom.liu@novomed.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T02:18:00+08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo for Novomed — timezone mismatch — proposed new slots

Hi Asha —

Totally understand, and I'm really sorry for the confusion on our side. I mistakenly created the calendar event in my calendar using PDT (UTC-7) which translated poorly into your SGT view. That was my error.

I've pulled a few APAC-friendly options and attached a corrected invite (redwood-demo-invite-corrected.ics) that is explicitly set to Singapore Time (SGT / UTC+8):
- Fri Jul 9, 09:30–10:00 SGT
- Fri Jul 9, 10:30–11:00 SGT
- Mon Jul 12, 09:00–09:30 SGT

If none of those work I can also do Tue Jul 13 morning (SGT). Stephanie (cc'd) handles EMEA/APAC scheduling and will confirm resource availability for the chosen slot.

I've re-attached the deck again for quick reference. Please pick the slot that works and I'll send a calendar invite that is explicitly SGT.

Attachments: Novomed-demo-deck-v3.pdf, redwood-demo-invite-corrected.ics

Thanks for being flexible — really want to make this run smoothly for your team.

Best,
Irene
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

On Wed, Jul 6, 2026 at 15:02 PDT Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Scheduling note: original invite was in PDT (my local).

---
", 'From: Asha Reddy <asha@novomed.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Tom Liu <tom.liu@novomed.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T03:02:00+08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo for Novomed — timezone mismatch — confirmed Jul 9 09:30 SGT

Hi Irene / Stephanie —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Jul 9, 09:30–10:00 SGT works for us — please send the calendar invite in SGT and include the Zoom link.

See you then.

Asha

On Thu, Jul 8, 2026 at 02:18 AM +08:00 Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com> wrote:
> I attached a corrected SGT invite — sending updated calendar now.

---
